description: Defines the TouchState struct which manages touch input states, including pointers, windows, and device info, for Android input dispatching.

classes.name: TouchState
classes.description: Manages the state of touch input, including active pointers, windows, and device info, for Android input handling.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the touch state to initial conditions.

methods.name: clearWindowsWithoutPointers
methods.description: Clears windows that do not have active pointers.

methods.name: removeTouchedPointer
methods.description: Removes a touched pointer by its ID.

methods.name: removeTouchedPointerFromWindow
methods.description: Removes a touched pointer from a specific window.

methods.name: addOrUpdateWindow
methods.description: Adds or updates a window with touch target info.

methods.name: addHoveringPointerToWindow
methods.description: Adds a hovering pointer to a window.

methods.name: removeHoveringPointer
methods.description: Removes a hovering pointer from a device.

methods.name: clearHoveringPointers
methods.description: Clears all hovering pointers.

methods.name: removeAllPointersForDevice
methods.description: Removes all pointers associated with a device.

methods.name: removeWindowByToken
methods.description: Removes a window based on its token.

methods.name: filterNonAsIsTouchWindows
methods.description: Filters out non-AsIs touch windows.

methods.name: cancelPointersForWindowsExcept
methods.description: Cancels pointers for all windows except the specified one.

methods.name: cancelPointersForNonPilferingWindows
methods.description: Cancels pointers for non-pilfering windows.

methods.name: getFirstForegroundWindowHandle
methods.description: Returns the first foreground window handle.

methods.name: isSlippery
methods.description: Checks if the touch state is slippery.

methods.name: getWallpaperWindow
methods.description: Returns the wallpaper window handle.

methods.name: getTouchedWindow
methods.description: Retrieves the touched window for a given window handle.

methods.name: isDown
methods.description: Checks if any window is currently being touched.

methods.name: hasHoveringPointers
methods.description: Checks if there are any hovering pointers.

methods.name: getWindowsWithHoveringPointer
methods.description: Gets windows with a specific hovering pointer.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the touch state.
